description: Cost-minimizing launch profile for a qualified DirectAdmin/cPanel shared host; hosting is an adapter/configuration choice, never a billing or entitlement authority.

authority_boundaries.provider_adapters: capability-qualified; never infer support from a platform name

requirements.node_runtime: Host-provided supported Node.js runtime with process environment injection
requirements.https: TLS must be managed by the host or reverse proxy
requirements.data_dir: Private, writable, outside public_html/web document root
requirements.billing_authority: BILLING_AUTHORITY_URL or IDENTITY_AUTHORITY_URL must be configured for production authorization
requirements.secrets: Inject via hosting environment/secret facility; never commit secrets
requirements.health: Host must route health/readiness probes to the application service

tiers.purpose: lowest-cost initial launch when Node runtime, private persistent storage and authority connectivity are supported
excludes: local file cache as production entitlement authority

tiers.purpose: upgrade when shared-host constraints block resource isolation or process control
features: same application code and env contract

tiers.purpose: upgrade after traction, official engagement, or funding
features: same application code and env contract
managed AWS resources via explicitly qualified adapters

invariant: Moving between shared hosting, VPS and AWS must not change AeroBill/Mandatag entitlement semantics, product policy, API contracts or the canonical capability registry.
